skill.name: brand-guidelines
skill.description: Provides Anthropic-style color and typography guidance for applying consistent brand styling to documents, slides, and visual artifacts.
skill.summary: Apply Anthropic-style colors, typography, and accents to visual artifacts.
skill.author: ArtemisAI

content.value_statement: Visual artifacts can drift from documented brand colors and typography. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code clear styling rules for Anthropic-style outputs.
actual_capabilities: Defines main Anthropic-style colors, including dark, light, gray, and accent values.
Specifies Poppins for headings and Lora for body text, with fallback fonts.
Guides smart color selection based on background contrast.
Describes accent color cycling for non-text shapes.
Explains RGB color use for consistent presentation styling.
limitations: It provides style guidance, not automated file conversion by itself.
Custom fonts must already be available for exact typography.
It focuses on Anthropic-style visual treatment, not full brand governance.
It does not verify legal permission to use protected brand assets.

use_cases.title: Refresh a Slide Deck
use_cases.description: Apply consistent colors, heading fonts, body fonts, and accent shapes to presentation content.

use_cases.title: Create Branded Launch Material
use_cases.description: Use the defined palette and typography to keep product announcements visually consistent.

use_cases.title: Standardize Visual Documentation
use_cases.description: Align diagrams, reports, and examples with a clear Anthropic-style visual system.

prompt_templates.title: Style a Document
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for basic brand application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the brand guidelines to this document. Use the defined colors, heading font, body font, and readable contrast.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh a Presentation
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for slide design updates.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update this presentation with Anthropic-style colors and typography. Keep the original structure, but improve visual consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Visual Consistency
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for reviewing an existing artifact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this artifact against the brand guidelines. Identify inconsistent colors, typography issues, and places where accents should be adjusted.

prompt_templates.title: Create Brand Implementation Guidance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for reusable design direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create concise implementation guidance for applying these brand rules across reports, slides, diagrams, and one-page summaries.

output_examples.input: A slide deck uses mixed fonts and several unrelated accent colors.
output_examples.output: Headings use Poppins or Arial. Body text uses Lora or Georgia. Accent shapes rotate through orange, blue, and green.

output_examples.input: A one-page report needs Anthropic-style visual polish.
output_examples.output: The report uses dark text, light backgrounds, subtle gray dividers, and restrained accent colors.

output_examples.input: A diagram needs better visual hierarchy and brand alignment.
output_examples.output: Primary labels use heading typography. Supporting labels use body typography. Non-text shapes use accent colors with clear contrast.

best_practices: Start with the provided color palette before adding any custom colors.
Keep heading and body font roles consistent across every artifact.
Check contrast after applying dark, light, and accent colors.
anti_patterns: Mixing unrelated brand palettes with the defined colors.
Applying accent colors to every element on a page.
Assuming the skill installs fonts or modifies files without user direction.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps apply Anthropic-style colors, typography, and accents to visual artifacts.

faq.question: Does it install Poppins or Lora fonts?
faq.answer: No. It uses those fonts when available and recommends Arial or Georgia as fallbacks.

faq.question: Can it style slide decks?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides guidance for headings, body text, shapes, backgrounds, and accent colors.

faq.question: Does it create official brand approvals?
faq.answer: No. It supports visual consistency, but it does not replace legal or brand review.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when an artifact needs consistent Anthropic-style visual formatting.
